answer: Bind each agent identity to a locked stake sealed by a rotating cipher: the cipher turns the agent's secret plus the epoch seed into exactly one valid ticket per epoch, so one operator can't conjure extra votes from thin air. Creating ten thousand fake identities means locking ten thousand separate stakes, each slashed if two tickets ever expose the same secret. The stake acts like pigment in water — one dyed thread stains every copy, and no plume of fake accounts can cover it. Sybils stop being free: an attacker must outspend honest agents per identity.
